steps.text: Hello. You've reached the office of Rhine Lab Control, Kristen Wright.
Ms. Wright is currently unable to take your call. Please leave your message after the tone. Thank you.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: This is bad, Kristen. I think I screwed up...

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: I'll admit the Colonel's smart. He caught onto my 'little tricks' last time I made a delivery.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: He's been all eyes on me along with Ferdinand's people. It took a whole bunch of clones just to get away here.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Ferdinand's gonna make his move at Rhine soon enough, I just know it... and the other Directors have to fall in line. The only other option is to play dumb.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Ugh, jeez. I might have nowhere to run anymore, seriously.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: I'm a little scared. Just a tiny, tiny bit, but... you get where I'm coming from, right?

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Not to worry, though. I'm still going to uphold our agreement, 100%.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: —Kristen... I can't help but wonder...

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: If she was still here, maybe we wouldn't...
Ms. Muelsyse, I suggest you stop struggling.
Your marathon from Rhine HQ to the commercial district's wasted our entire evening.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Lemme guessie, dead end for me?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You'll always catch me as long as I'm somewhere in Trimounts.
No. Forget Trimounts. It'd be the same in any city.
This is Columbia. The charges stick to lawbreakers, rain or shine.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: This is about me breaking confidentiality with the military, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: In which case, you should give me some time to call my lawyer—and not sic a kajillion armed mercs on me in the middle of the street.
I'll say again. We're in Columbia.
We don't operate by the books unless 'by the books' is what we need. In other scenarios, we like efficiency.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright. Do I still get a little chat with Ferdinand? Maybe me and him can still straighten out this whole mix-up before it's too late.
Nuh-uh. That's not in my orders here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: D... Didn't Ferdinand hire you?
Ferdinand Clooney might be your coworker, but he's just a partner of convenience to me.
I've got no personal stake in the Rhine infighting. Ecological? Energy? I don't give a damn and my employer doesn't care who exactly we're cooperating with.
What we want is results. Rhine Lab provides the goods, my employer puts thought into their use.
And your tiny little 'oops moment' lost you the last ounces of our trust.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I said... I didn't mean to, would you believe me?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm a researcher, ya know? I've got this habit of hanging onto test data here and there.
Habit? You had all this time to think of an excuse, and that's it?
I'm so, so sorry to tell you, your fancy brand of charisma doesn't work on me.
I'm given to understand Ferdinand warned you not to let a whisper of any of the testing leak before the government passed every bill tied to it.
Your Elven blood's stretched the expiration date on your good looks. That likewise ensures you don't form any forgetful habits, right?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You—!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You know I'm...
An Elf?
I read the files. I know who I'm working with. Part of my job, y'see.
So, come, let's cooperate some. Whatever illusion you were going to concoct next, it'd be as useless as the last.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Sheesh, I guess I really am cornered.
I guess that's why you were stalling so long... You think you can dupe me?
I'm not the brute forcing type, I don't go off half-cocked, and I'm not one of your colleagues married to the lab.
Got you.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: At this temperature... water molecules... don't hear my call...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Is this your Arts... or some kind of special technology?
Are you really free enough to discuss issues of science with me, 'Director' Muelsyse?
Sorry, but I'm tired of playing hide-and-seek, and I don't want any sudden 'acts' of iced water getting my plumage or hair wet.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hahah... you're... no ordinary merc...
Flattered.
Now, you still have one last chance—answer my question.
Kristen Wright, Rhine Lab Control, has spent the past several years buying up a massive amount of high-purity hard material from companies high and low. What kind of experiment is she running?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hfff... hkaah... why are you helping Ferdinand if you and your employer—care so much about Control's tests?
That's not the right answer. That's not AN answer. That's another question, in fact.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I don't have... any of... the answers you're looking for.
Your file says you love using your blood-given abilities to toy with people. I'm a little surprised you turned out to be so loyal to the Control.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Loyal...?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm just... looking out for... myself...
Aww... you're telling me you don't want this chance at all.
In which case, Ms. Muelsyse—
Our partnership is hereby terminated.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Terminated...?
Terminate her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Saria...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You've gotta make it in time... for Kristen...
2:43 A.M. \ Overcast
Main District of Trimounts

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: Still waiting for your appointment, ma'am?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: She should've been here ten minutes ago.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've never counted on her to be punctual, but if our last comms were anything to go by, she was the one desperate for this meeting.

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: Maybe she backed out again...

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: We all know the Director of Rhine Lab Ecological prefers to hide the truth behind all those smiles of hers.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I don't trust Muelsyse.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I wouldn't easily trust anyone choosing to remain at Rhine Lab at this point.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: But partnerships are built on more than just trust. Did you trust me the moment I first met you?

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: *cough*... The truth, ma'am?

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: When I saw you standing outside my door, I almost went straight to the kitchen to grab a knife or something, and call the cops along the way.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Good head on your shoulders.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Still, Rhine Lab wouldn't use force to threaten a retired employee who signed an NDA.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: At least, not while I was still in Defense.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: A new message?

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: Something wrong, ma'am? You look serious... serious enough to give me shivers.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Change of plans.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Muelsyse isn't coming.

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: S... Something happened to her? Right when she was about to meet you?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Erikson, I need a favor.

steps.name: Trimountarian
steps.text: W-What is it?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Send the info I received to the local branch of this pharmaceutical company.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Ask their operators to immediately inform Dr. Kal'tsit and Dr. {@nickname}—I know they've been in Columbian territory recently.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I need their help.
5:11 A.M. \ Overcast
Test Site 359, Trimounts Outskirts

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Morning, Doctor. You're up as early as ever.

options: Well-regulated circadian rhythm promotes stability of core data.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: D... Data? You mean physiologically, right?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Haha, you always pack that special sense of humor.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: *sigh*... I pulled an all-nighter just to get these figures. Director Franks is gonna rag on me for this.

options: Negative. Scenario inconsistent with typical behavior of Dorothy Franks.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Uh, is that supposed to reassure me?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Thanks... but even if she lets it fly, there's still Director Clooney, and I don't wanna go back to him...
You're overdue for a good night's sleep, Helen.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Elena... you know we have evaluations next week. How am I supposed to sleep with an eval weighing on me?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: I can't lose this job. I'm still paying off my student loans...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Sorry, I know I keep bringing that up.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Hm... how's this sound? I'll raise your situation with the Director once the experiment's over.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: S-Seriously? Elena... you're the only one in all of Energy who isn't terrified of Director Clooney. What's your secret?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You've just gotta be like me...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Spending every single day in the lab, making the Director happy with every last thing you do? Th—That's not realistic for me...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Oh, right! I needed to check in with Director Franks! Gotta go!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I made coffee. You want some?

options: Excessive caffeine intake may aggravate Oripathy, Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I hear you, but I'm still not about to give up my life for the word 'may.'

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If the docs had the final word, I'd be best off staying at Rhodes Island with my sister.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Same for you, right, Joyce? Medical wants you aboard long-term.

options: Regulations state I must report back to Rhine Lab at regular intervals.
Provision of medical services at this site is only a temporary assignment.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sure... just a few days, and then you'll meet back up with Dr. Silence in the city, right?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Me and Dorothy'll miss you.
Joyce needs rest. Work gets too intense here at the site.
And you, Elena. If it wasn't for Ferdinand talking you up as his most outstanding researcher, I'd be on the case to kick you back to the city too.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: So you're here at last, Dorothy.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Helen just went looking for you. You didn't run into her?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Sorry, I wasn't paying attention...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Seriously, you're gonna work until you faint, huh?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Forget me and Joyce, how many days have you gone without sleep? I've seen the wrappers filling up your lab's trash can over the past week. Agrypnotics, huh?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The experiment's already in its final phase. I promised the participants I'd accelerate the pace, so they can get back to their families sooner.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Got me there. Who doesn't want this done sooner?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Plus, as your assistant, I have to listen to you anyway.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Alright—can I ask my beloved assistant to do me another little favor, then?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I can't be out of the lab for too long. I want you to courier these heat-emitter modules to some friends outside.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Heat-emitters? We've been in the barrens for over a month. Where'd you buy these?

options: Warning. Rhine Lab technological components detected.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: See? It took me and Joyce one look to know you made these with lab materials.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The living fossils up in Business won't like that. You might be Originium Art's Director, but that's not gonna change their tune any.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I know how their minds work.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And I know even better that you won't report something this minor to Ferdinand, or any of the Directors for that matter.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They need these things. It's been getting cold lately, and their huts weren't built to last. They won't keep the chills out.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've been wanting to say... Don't you think you worry too much about them?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: They're... Pioneers. A team of them in Rhine Lab's employ.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No Pioneer's gonna hang around anywhere for long, let alone make friends.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They're just a bunch of kids.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Besides, I know what you're trying to say. You're worried about me. You're worried I'll feel empty once they're gone.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: That's my little assistant, always so considerate...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Don't grin at me like that. You're not my teacher, Director Franks.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Elena...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Fine, I'll do you this one last favor. The very last one.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Seeing as... the experiment's nearly over.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Sir, we're all set.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Sonny... Sir?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Got the heebie-jeebies?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What? Nah, that's never been my style.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: You've been pacing laps about the cabin. Seven, coming up eight.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I'm just, uh... I'm getting my mind in order. Lotta variables, what's coming up next.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Sonny, I've been thinking, but, uh, are we really on the right track here?

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Them scientists, and the doc, they've been plenty good to us, I say.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I told y'all already, one or two acts of kindness don't make a saint.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Back in law school, my classmates loved to do all that charitable business—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You know, donate a thing or three to treatment zones for Infected, maybe join a campus debate for justice, for what they went through.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But once I came to be an unlucky, ill-ridden son-of-a-gun too, well, guess how many times they visited me?

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Not a single goddamned time.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: A year back, I went to borrow some money from an old college roommate. He worked at the biggest law firm in Max D.C.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Picked up the phone, get this. He asked me who I was.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: 'Sorry, you were out deferred for treatment, so that's why the grad yearbook didn't have your contact.' —Ha!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Most touching joke I ever heard, I tell you.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Real band of bastards, huh? We've seen plenty of 'em ourselves, all of us.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Once they're at a safe enough distance, it stokes their egos good to throw out a little benevolence, like they're feeding fowl, and it makes a topic for their get-togethers too.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You go on and guess... if right this moment, in that laboratory, those respectable scientists are cradling their coffee cups talking about us, huh?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Nobody minds doling out good intent, not until it costs them anything for real.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Alright, boss, whatever you say.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: You seen the most of us, paid it most mind. Your word is gold.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: This is the only way we've got.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Nobody in the whole damned test site's gonna look out for us, 'cept ourselves.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: C'mon, Joyce, once I finish my coffee, we've got to get to work.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Medic... we need a medic!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're one of the Pioneers?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You can't really just come in... uh, you haven't gone through decontam yet...

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Don't you have a medic or a doctor? Something came over Sam all of a sudden, he's sick!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sick...? Is it Oripathy?!

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Are you? Are you a doctor? You gotta save him, you gotta save ol' Sam, save us all!

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: He's been running like a kettle since late last night, and he's just started throwing up blood!

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: He's in the nearest hut... We did like you told us last time, gave him some painkillers, laid him down.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joyce...!

options: Apologies. Other tasks have reduced priority.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... I know.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm not trying to stop you, even if we're shattering safety regulations...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joyce, I'm gonna go with you.

options: You are not a medical worker, Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Who gives two cares? Remember, I took basic medical training too. An extra pair of helping hands can't hurt in a situation like this, right?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Plus I've gotta make the trip anyway, with my errand from Dorothy. Might as well be now.

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Here!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Where's the patient?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Out of the way! Every second counts with acute Oripathy onset!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Pioneer
steps.text: Don't move!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Is that... a nail gun?

options: There are no cases of acute Oripathy onset in the vicinity.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sure aren't, Joyce. These are some healthy young men here.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wouldn't have the strength to be pointing dangerous tools at us otherwise.
Hands up, ladies.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're... the leader of the Pioneer Team.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You remember me? I admit I'm a touch surprised.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sir, why have you tricked me and Joyce into coming here?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I trust you know, Urbica... Dr. Urbica.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That's how you say your surname, right?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You pronounced it beautifully...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Gonna trouble you to lend us your communicator there, Doc.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Pioneer Team needs to ask your superiors a few questions.
